_: ConcordeGo's changes as go.flyconcordefly.com/changes listed them, newest first. Written by tools/sync-releases.py in the Sync releases Action; the Release notes summarize the last 30 days of it.

changes.summary: A cleaner Home on computers: the friends card and your cards side by side, level and in one style
Find friends at the airport: a pass on Home shows the travelers at your airport today, with a group chat and Add friend
Search engines now skip the app's behind-the-scenes addresses
Each flight named for the airline you fly, grades you can read by day, whole airline names on phones, and many more cities found at once
Smoother tabs with one sliding pill, and the corner banner only on Home
One glass style across Home, a search bar that glows as you type, buttons that press in, and places with accents like Reykjavík now search
Home's map now fills the screen edge to edge
The corner banner takes the colour of the time of day, without the plane
The corner banner keeps to two colours: lavender on dark skies, indigo on light ones
Faster searches that ask every flight source at once, and a lighter page to download
Flights land into place when results arrive, and the logo's plane sits clear of its stripes
The striped corner banner is back on Home, wider, with the plane tucked against it
The logo's lavender stripes are back, shooting in like speed lines as the page opens
On phones, Where to? sits right under today's flight
Home balances the map and your cards to fill the window, the Concorde mark sits in the corner
The demo's Plan to meet opens the made-up friend's chat with the first line written
The hero's recent searches keep to one short line; airline tiles stand off the glass
Plan to meet a friend straight from the top pick, and the results, trips, Friends and Meet in the hero's light
Type a place on Home and press Enter to see flights; recent searches one tap under the bar
Front page test follows friends on the map
Places to go on the map beside your next trip, one tap to flights
A bolder Home: the full map behind, the destination lit in chrome with a passing glint, and glass that glows
A simpler trip page, one clear timeline with each step a single line, and Home's cards always the full width
Your trips now spans the same width as the map above it
A simpler Home with only your trips and what's new by default, and tabs that slide
Tap a place to search it right away, a more beautiful heading, and simpler search defaults
A cleaner Home: the search and two clear tiles, find a flight and find your friends, with the page centred and empty cards gone
Cleaner pages: one left edge on every tab, quieter page buttons, tidier empty cards and results header
A simpler, centred front page with the search up front, and Settings now shows only what works
Fixes across Home and the social tabs: Back moves between tabs, side panels no longer freeze the page, friend chips on the map open, and removing a trip asks first
Smoother tabs, cards that lift under the pointer, and leaner result rows with one footer
Trip ideas on an empty map, tidier Home cards, a simpler passport card, Back that works, and the 2nd and 3rd picks back in the results list
Version 0.5: a calmer welcome, smoother moves between screens, a route card with a plane while flights load, and Cash or Points no longer reshuffles the results
Type just a city to search: the Magic trip box suggests places as you type, fills in where you fly from, and the opening plays every visit
Search results now show which friends are around each flight: in the city you land in, at your connection, and the meet-ups at your airports
